messages:
Omar: Heads up - flight canceled and venue closed due to flooding. Had to grab a last-minute taxi and small cash hotel for a few hours. Company card is locked in the office. Can I get a cash advance for the taxi back to the airport or will I just expense later?

Priya: Sorry about that Omar. For immediate transit we can approve a petty cash advance up to regional limit (EMEA/NA $100, APAC local equivalents). Submit a petty cash request form and ping People Ops. If petty cash isn't feasible, expense the taxi later and mark as 'Emergency transit' in Expensify for expedited processing.

Omar: I'm still at the venue and vendors are only taking cash. I bought snacks and bottled water (~$9) and the driver only accepted cash (~$42). No POS receipts, just a handwritten receipt from the driver and the bank txn for the hotel.

Sam: For the handwritten taxi receipt, take a photo and include a short note with pickup/dropoff times and driver name if available. Policy allows handwritten receipts for taxis under $50 with a photo and attestation. For hotel: upload folio or a card txn screenshot.

People Ops Bot: Quick checklist: 1) Petty cash request OR expense submission within 5 business days; 2) Attach photos of handwritten receipts + attestation; 3) Set Expensify policy = "Travel - Emergency" and tag with incident code if known; 4) For amounts < $10 we may not require itemized receipt but still need a photo.

Omar: Is there any waiver for missing receipts if card failed and vendor is small mom-and-pop? I really don't have an official invoice.

Priya: Yes, limited exception: missing-receipt waiver can be applied for expenses < $75 that are travel-related and unavoidable (e.g., emergency transit, venue closed). Include a short description and your manager's approval in the expense notes. Finance will require manager approval and People Ops sign-off before reimbursement.

Finance Bot: Note: Foreign currency cash will be reimbursed using the exchange rate from the txn date. If your bank doesn't show an exact match, Finance will use the rate from XE on that date. Please include the currency and approximate local amount in your notes.

Omar: Submitted petty cash request and an Expensify claim (tagged emergency-199876). Uploaded photos: handwritten taxi receipt, hotel folio (folio#H-4492), bank txn screenshot. Manager approved in notes.

People Ops Bot: Received. Petty cash pick-up scheduled at 15:00 local (region ops counter). Finance: please expedite review once petty cash is confirmed or route to off-cycle ACH if petty cash not picked up.

Finance Bot: Claim 1998765432 received and flagged for emergency routing (ticket FIN-2026-0881). Off-cycle ACH possible within 48 hours pending verification. If petty cash is picked up, mark claim as partial-paid in Expensify.

Sam: We'll also file an action to check why company cards were inaccessible on-site and follow up with travel ops.

Omar: Thanks everyone, appreciate the fast responses. Will update when cash picked up. :pray:
